text: Reach the normal attribute ceiling
将这项属性练到原版上限
hint: Use the normal ceiling shown above, including native attribute modifiers.
以本栏显示的原版上限为准，包含原版属性倍率。

text: Keep a slime in each ear
让两耳同时寄生史莱姆
hint: Both parasites must still be present when the breakthrough is checked.
突破时两耳都必须仍有史莱姆，不是曾经寄生过即可。

text: Successfully resist possession in the lake prison
在湖底监狱成功抵抗附身
hint: Win the possession resistance check in the Ivory Wraith’s underwater prison.
指白色幽灵的湖底废墟监狱，成功抵抗它的附身。

text: Complete Schism
完成分裂结局
hint: Finish the native Schism sequence. Entering it alone does not count.
完成分裂剧情，走到它的结尾。只经历开头还不够。

text: Finish the temple vigil
完成神殿守夜
hint: Stay through the final hour of the native vigil.
在神殿坚持守完整夜，直到最后一小时结束。

text: The Ivory Wraith is currently recovering
白色幽灵当前处于恢复阶段
hint: This describes the Wraith, not your recovery. A victory in the prison can make it withdraw temporarily. Search while it is absent.
恢复的是白色幽灵，不是你。在监狱战胜它后，它会暂时退去恢复，趁它不在时搜索。

text: Reach the fourth prison search step
将湖底监狱的搜索推进到第4步
hint: Search for a way out, examine the cages, keep searching, then swim down the stairs. Return to the prison’s main page while the Wraith is recovering and select “Dive towards the rune again”.
依次寻找出路、检查笼子、继续搜索、游下楼梯。白色幽灵仍在恢复时返回监狱主页面，再选择“再次潜向符文”完成突破剧情。

text: Reach the normal attribute ceiling
将这项属性练到原版上限
hint: Use the normal ceiling shown above, including native attribute modifiers.
以本栏显示的原版上限为准，包含原版属性倍率。

text: Complete a successful flats break-in encounter
完成公寓潜入的成功脱困
hint: Break into a locked flat in the native block of flats (lockpicking 200). Escape through the physique or smashing route, or win the resulting fight. Your purchased home is unrelated.
从原版公寓区的上锁房间撬锁潜入，需诡术200。成功通过体格脱困、砸开障碍或赢得对应战斗。不是购买的房产。

text: Reach the late farm assault
经历第12阶段的农场袭击
hint: Progress Alex’s farm route and encounter the assault with farm stage at least 12.
推进艾利克斯农场路线，在农场阶段至少为12时经历袭击。

text: Complete the recorded farm confrontation
经历相关农场对抗
hint: The farm group confrontation, axe-fight victory or lorry-fight conclusion can supply this record.
经历相关农场群战，或完成斧战胜利、货车战结尾，都可以满足这一项。

text: Escape from the pound
从收容所脱困
hint: Finish the native pound escape sequence. This is not the asylum.
完成原版动物收容所的脱困流程，不是精神病院。

text: Reach the normal attribute ceiling
将这项属性练到原版上限
hint: Use the normal ceiling shown above, including native attribute modifiers.
以本栏显示的原版上限为准，包含原版属性倍率。

text: Once reach 7,000 base allure outdoors
曾在户外达到7000基础魅惑
hint: The event must occur outside a blood moon. This is base allure, not total allure.
在非血月的日子里，于户外达到要求。这里看的是基础魅惑，不是总魅惑。

text: Currently have at least 1,000 modelling fame
积累至少1000模特名声
hint: Build native modelling fame through modelling work.
通过原版模特工作积累模特名声。

text: Currently wear no makeup or coloured contacts
卸去妆容和美瞳
hint: Remove all listed makeup and contact lenses before the check.
突破时卸去全部化妆与美瞳。

text: Currently wear no face mask
取下面罩
hint: Remove face items tagged as masks before the check.
突破时取下带面罩标签的面部物品。

text: Reach the normal attribute ceiling
将这项属性练到原版上限
hint: Use the normal ceiling shown above, including native attribute modifiers.
以本栏显示的原版上限为准，包含原版属性倍率。

text: Finish the required nude swimming lesson
完成累计至少5次的裸泳课程
hint: Ask to swim naked in school swimming classes, then complete the recorded backstroke stage once the counter reaches five. Merely undressing at the pool does not count.
在学校游泳课申请裸泳，累计至少5次后完成对应仰泳阶段。只在泳池脱衣不算。

text: Continue dancing naked at Avery’s party
在艾弗里约会宴会中坚持裸体跳舞
hint: Follow Avery’s party dance competition and continue dancing after becoming fully naked. The underwear ending and the mod’s home banquet do not count.
指艾弗里约会中的派对舞蹈比赛，完全裸露后继续跳舞。内衣结局或模组房产宴会不算。

text: Complete the High Street photo run with 250 flyers
完成至少250张传单的商业街裸奔拍摄
hint: Use Niki’s High Street photo assignment, finish the successful run with your face shown, then reach its street ending. A studio nude shoot is unrelated.
指妮奇的商业街拍摄任务，在传单至少250张时成功完成露脸裸奔，并完成街头结尾。不是摄影棚内的裸体拍摄。

text: Reach the normal attribute ceiling
将这项属性练到原版上限
hint: Use the normal ceiling shown above, including native attribute modifiers.
以本栏显示的原版上限为准，包含原版属性倍率。

text: Obtain Wildsong through Gwylan’s ritual
通过格威岚仪式获得野歌
hint: Complete the native ritual result that awards Wildsong.
完成原版授予野歌的仪式结果。

text: Successfully conduct the sealing ritual yourself
亲自主持并成功完成封印仪式
hint: Before selecting the mod’s conduct option, have at least 20 purges and three dates of each ritual type. Finish with a successful seal and at least nine purge effectiveness.
净化累计至少20，与格威岚的两类仪式约会各至少3次后，在仪式选择页选择亲自主持。最终须成功封印且净化效力至少9。

text: Reach the normal promiscuity ceiling
当前淫乱达到原版上限
hint: A breakthrough in the other two attributes is not required.
不要求另外两项已经完成突破。

text: Reach the normal exhibitionism ceiling
当前暴露癖达到原版上限
hint: Use the normal ceiling, not the increased breakthrough ceiling.
达到原版上限即可，不要求突破后的新上限。

text: Reach the normal deviancy ceiling
当前异种癖达到原版上限
hint: All three values must meet their normal ceilings at the same time.
三项数值需要同时达到各自的原版上限。
